title: Everything hate you
description: This mod make every mob in the game hate you chase you and trying to kill you so watch out from chickens!
body: Every mob in Minecraft turns on you — animals, villagers, monsters, even your own tamed pets all hunt and attack on sight. Passive mobs hit back too. Survive if you can.
